Thanks for the ping — I reviewed the Synergia draft and put together prioritized comments (first-pass). High level: most items are standard but there are three items that need negotiation now to avoid downstream cycles. See bullets below.

Top-priority redlines (impact on commercial/SLAs):
- Data residency (Section 6): They want EU/US specific residency carveouts. Ask: confirm which regions they will require; we can offer US or EU dedicated residency on Dedicated/Private tiers but hosted has constraints. If they need contractually guaranteed residency, we should surface Dedicated as the required plan and note uplift.
- Liability cap (Section 12): their cap is unlimited for certain IP indemnities. Propose: $5M overall cap with carveout for willful misconduct.
- SLA remedies (Section 9): they request financial credits for latency SLO misses. We do credits for availability but not per-token latency credits. Recommend we propose an operational SLA + remediation plan (priority routing/fallback) vs. financial credits.

Secondary items (can be handled in iteration):
- Subprocessors list: provide current list and commit to notice period for changes (30 days)
- Billing cadence: 45 days is uncommon for new logos; finance prefers net 30 on hosted usage. Jordan to confirm whether a one-time exception is acceptable for this enterprise pilot.

Attachments referenced: Synergia-Security-Profile.pdf (I created a short packet combining our SOC2 summary and current subprocessor list); included a redline export (tracked changes) — but I'll upload final tracked changes to the contract folder and share link.

Recommended next steps:
1) Jordan — confirm billing concession possibility by EOD tomorrow (6/6).
2) Jonas — set a call with Synergia for early next week (30 min) to walk redlines and residency options.
3) Marissa — can you add a one-page memo summarizing the security artifacts we'll provide (SOC2 scope, retention, encryption at rest) to attach to the redline?

I will prepare a first-pass marked-up MSA and a cover note for sending to Synergia.
